name: Lady Blaumeux
text: Come, Zeliek, do not drive them out. Not before we've had our fun!

name: Bradensbrook Villager
text: What in blazes happened to my chickens?

name: Ren'Zuli
text: Blood God... take me! Dis not... be... da end...

name: Lieutenant Piet
text: You fool, you were followed! To arms!

name: Eredar Riftweaver
text: You cannot stop us. We are infinite.

name: Mayla Highmountain
text: When you face the worms, call to us, and we shall be there.

name: Prince Malchezaar
text: How can you hope to stand against such overwhelming power?

name: Dark Acolyte
text: You will make a fine sacrifice!

name: Echo of Valok
text: How dare you suggest such a thing!

name: Shade of the Horseman
text: Prepare yourselves, the bells have tolled! Shelter your weak, your young and your old! Each of you shall pay the final sum. Cry for mercy, the reckoning has come!

name: Alonsus Faol
text: In times such as these, we cannot afford to turn away those willing to help. We welcome you, as our new ally.

name: Sara
text: The time to strike at the head of the beast will soon be upon us! Focus your anger and hatred on his minions!

name: Prophet Velen
text: In time, the light and hope held within - will rebirth more than this mere fount of power... Mayhap, they will rebirth the soul of a nation.

name: Ace
text: We know you were getting ready to attack us. You brought this on yourselves.

name: Wormtalon Huntress
text: I will rip you to shreds!

name: Prince Malchezaar
text: You are but a plaything. Unfit even to amuse.

name: Prince Oceanus
text: Go away, tiny creature, or I will have you for a snack.

name: Skyhorn Pathfinder
text: They took us by surprise at night.

name: Wrathsteed of Xoroth
text: I will cut you down myself!

name: Sturdy Love Fool
text: It was only the one time.

name: Taran Zhu
text: Hatred will consume and conquer all!

name: Samuel Williams
text: You will all drown in the lightless abyss.

name: Dread Crewman
text: Keep your eyes peeled. The admiral is not to be disturbed.

name: Vineyard Warden
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Nightborne Wretch
text: So generous! Thank you, I owe you my life!

name: Jace Darkweaver
text: We must get the wards reignited. Otherwise, I guarantee the Legion will overrun our position and pour into Azsuna.

name: Azshj'thul the Drowned
text: The sunken realm welcomes your yawning souls.

name: Kor'kron Assassin
text: Call for your king, $rt! Draw him in!

name: Ace
text: You naga keep your distance. We're not kidding around here!

name: Gog'rak
text: The last time I saw Orac, he was chasing Icepaw out the southern gates of Wor'gol.

name: Ephial
text: Rise, and carry out my will!

name: Mobile Alert System
text: Warning! Warning! Intruder alert! Intruder alert!

name: Caregiver Felaani
text: Oh, thank the Light for you, stranger!

name: Princess Tess Greymane
text: You will not regret this choice, Shadowblade. I will take out any Legion demon or conspirator who crosses my path!

name: Midnight
text: Perhaps you would rather test yourselves against a more formidable opponent?!

name: Darkfallen Slave
text: Be swift before the pits consume you!

name: Dalaran Citizen
text: The skull on that axe looks... hungry.

name: Sara
text: What do you want from me? Leave me alone!

name: Azshj'thul the Drowned
text: No light. No escape. The forgotten king returns.

name: Lorewalker Stonestep
text: I can allow this no longer!

name: Ancient Citizen
text: I am trying to listen. Go away!

name: Mr. Shackle
text: Welcome to our humble place of business, traveler.

name: Reclaimer A'zak
text: Anub'Arak has fallen, my brothers! Rise from the depths and reclaim our birthright!

name: Brann Bronzebeard
text: The iron dwarves have been seen emerging from the bunkers at the base of the pillars straight ahead of you! Destroy the bunkers, and they'll be forced to fall back!

name: Cleaver Bmurglbrm
text: Psst... $r, over here! Next to the dead whale.

name: Moira Thaurissan
text: Shimmer Ridge. I know it well. The Frostmane trolls breed and plot above the snow-blown mesa.

name: King Mrgl-Mrgl
text: There, $n, now you will be able to speak with, and understand, the Winterfin murlocs.

name: Necrolord Azael
text: Alive or dead, I tower over you!

name: Sashj'tar Deep Witch
text: I will cut you into eel food!

name: Allari the Souleater
text: $p, you must enter the soul gem and force Arev'naal to reveal Lord Illidan's location.

name: Master Bu
text: You have shown patience with Master Bu, honor with the grummles, duty with the Shado-Pan, and faith with the jinyu.

name: Priestess of Eyir
text: Champion, I bring you the favor of Eyir! Approach and obtain her blessing.

name: Majordomo Executus
text: Brashly, you have come to wrest the secrets of the Living Flame! You will soon regret the recklessness of your quest.

name: Helix Gearbreaker
text: The mistress will pay me handsomely for your heads!

name: Human Archmage
text: Invisibility will not last long. Let's go!

name: Grom'kar Deckhand
text: You'll never make it out alive!

name: Durotan
text: Champion! It is good that you have joined us! I will hold these Thunderlord off in case any of your allies arrive.

name: Pandaren Cannoneer
text: Quickly, this way! The cannon fire has opened a passage to the courtyard!

name: Sathrovarr the Corruptor
text: I have toyed with you long enough!

name: Stelleris Vigilant
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Captain Skarloc
text: Did you really think you would leave here alive?

name: Jepetto Joybuzz
text: Oh, goodie. A new box of toys!

name: Skyhorn Pathfinder
text: They were going to feed us to their basilisks!

name: Gorkun Ironskull
text: Brave champions, we owe you our lives, our freedom.... Though it be a tiny gesture in the face of this enormous debt, I pledge that from this day forth, all will know of your deeds, and the blazing path of light you cut through the shadow of this dark citadel.

name: Julwaba
text: I need to head back to de arena. Be careful out dere. Jakra'zet has put a hefty price on your head.

name: Warlord Zaela
text: They have broken into the tower. Destroy it!

name: Stelleris Libertine
text: I yield! I'll tell you anything!

name: Zardrax the Empowerer
text: No... my link to G'huun is... fading?

name: Master Bu
text: It is clear you embody the wisdom, integrity, and tenacity of a grandmaster. Only one test remains... Prove to me that you can fight like a grandmaster!

name: Prince Malchezaar
text: You face not Malchezaar alone, but the legions I command!

name: Stranded Battalion Soldier
text: I will not forget your bravery.

name: Bonespeaker Mystic
text: You are not worthy of being here!

name: Warlord Zaela
text: Turn the cannons on the tower! Bury them alive!

name: Caregiver Felaani
text: I just want to take my daughter and leave. We aren't any threat to you.

name: Bilgerudder
text: I'll murder all of you if I don't see some wins out there!

name: Bronzebeard Radio
text: You've done it! You've broken the defenses of Ulduar. In a few moments, we will be dropping in to...

name: Seeker of Wisdom
text: The Burning Legion killed my family. Die!

name: Scout Valdez
text: $gSir:Ma'am;, I have some recent threats sketched out on the map here whenever you're ready.

name: Challe Tebrilinde
text: Cannot fail... I will not fail...

name: Image of Zardrax the Empowerer
text: No! Nana'kwug! Now I have to...

name: Darkfiend Corruptor
text: Looking for a fight? Allow me...

name: Grelda the Hag
text: Howww did it get passst the daughters?! We will feassst on its insssides!

name: Darkfiend Corruptor
text: Pity. You could have joined us...

name: Alonsus Faol
text: May the Light shine upon you.

name: Risen Assassin
text: No obstacle shall stand in our way.

name: Sathrovarr the Corruptor
text: Haven't you heard? I always win!

name: Torcalin Cleric
text: Blood magic be forbidden! Da traitors must be stopped!

name: Dark Ranger Velonara
text: The Dark Lady has lent her rangers to your cause, $ct.

name: High Astromancer Solarian
text: Enough of this!  Now I call upon the fury of the cosmos itself.

name: Taran Zhu
text: Taran Zhu and the Shado-Pan are MINE. Come forward and die by my hand, as all who oppose me shall in the days to come!

name: Wretched Husk
text: You wish to steal the power!  Die!

name: Grand Admiral Westwind
text: ENOUGH! I waste my time here. I must gather my strength on the homeworld.

name: Defiant Troll
text: Sorry, mon. It won't happen again.

name: Feltotem Demonkindre
text: I smell blood in the forest.

name: Commander Malt'his
text: What's thisss? A trespasser intrudesss on our conversation.

name: Outcast Shadeweaver
text: Iskar will guide us to freedom.

name: Bilgerudder
text: Come on, $p, talk with Sternfathom. Let's get this fight started!

name: Seeker of Wisdom
text: I'm just as good with a sword as I am with spells. Any preference?

name: Brann Bronzebeard
text: Okay! Let's move out. Get into your machines; I'll speak to you from here via the radio!

name: Shade of the Horseman
text: Fire consumes! You've tried and failed.  Let there be no doubt, justice prevailed!

name: Captured Farmer
text: Thank goodness you're here. Those cookpots were getting empty...

name: Cliffclutch Screecher
text: I will rip you to shreds!

name: Tarren Mill Lookout
text: Something riled that horse. Let's go!

name: Ginger Blockgear
text: I must have this, the detail is outstanding!

name: Grand Admiral Westwind
text: You'll never defeat the Lich King without my forces. I'll have my revenge... on him AND you!

name: Deathcaller Mystic
text: You are not worthy of being here!

name: Throm'var Villager
text: The human wizard and his pet elf are to blame. The land knows they don't belong.

name: Grom'kar Deckhand
text: You'll never make it out alive!

name: Majordomo Executus
text: You think you've won already? Perhaps you'll need another lesson in pain!

name: Felborne Enforcer
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Barnes
text: Splendid. I'm going to get the audience ready. Break a leg!

name: Counselor Talbot
text: The power you've bestowed upon me has granted me great mental influence over human minds.  I bear these offerings as proof of my progress.

name: Master Bu
text: But in the midst of that reflection, I saw something new and interesting appear... you!

name: Frightened Prisoner
text: They were going to feed us to the beast Aku'mai. There are more prisoners deeper in the dungeon. Please, save them!

name: Tichondrius
text: Pathetic! You're putting me to sleep. Here, let me return the favor!

name: Xuen
text: The elements walk in harmony with this one. I've not seen a better shaman since I fought alongside Thrall himself.

name: Skyhorn Pathfinder
text: This is why I hate caves.

name: High Mage of the Duskwatch
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Helarjar Soulhunter
text: I will bathe in your blood!

name: Duskwatch Orbitist
text: Confess! You are harboring traitors to Suramar!

name: Khan Ablinh
text: What is this? FAKE! Splithoof, $n and the gnomes have tried to fool us. Kill $g him : her;!

name: Grom'kar Technician
text: You'll never make it out alive!

name: Master Bu
text: Filled with sorrow by the death of Grandmaster Hight, I wandered Pandaria to reflect.

name: Vaultwarden Umbra
text: ... I have failed you my lord, Detheroc...

name: Counselor Talbot
text: Allow me to take care of the intruders, lord.  I will feed their entrails to the maggots.

name: Thane Wildsky
text: You will not bar my way.

name: Concerned Attendant
text: You should have fled when you had the chance.

name: Nightborne Infiltrator
text: I cannot lose to a lowborn!

name: Leleyna
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Helarjar Soulthief
text: I will bathe in your blood!

name: Thunderlord Invader
text: We will crush you just the same!

name: Medivh
text: Orcs of the Horde! This portal is the gateway to your new destiny! Azeroth lies before you, ripe for the taking!

name: Vulpera Kid
text: I told you Meerah wouldn't forget about us! She's the best!

name: Li Li
text: I TOLD you he was weird.

name: Tichondrius
text: Never trust a mortal to do a demon's work!

name: Stelleris Vigilant
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Kvaldir Soulflayer
text: I will bathe in your blood!

name: Officer Rumsfeld
text: We must focus all of our efforts into the mines. I agree with Dr. Jones, the Artifact has to be there. It has to be!

name: Samuel Williams
text: They are redemption. They are truth.

name: Ensign Ward
text: Champion! I bear orders from Greymane!

name: Captain Skarloc
text: I don't know what Blackmoore sees in you. For my money you're just another ignorant savage!

name: Millhouse Manastorm
text: I have no idea what goes on here, but I will gladly join your fight against this impudent imbecile!

name: Summoner Yarz
text: Haha... it be too late... da Blood God.. be here!

name: Tichondrius
text: Laughable! As if you had a prayer of stopping the ritual...

name: Aurore
text: Thank you. Do let Ly'leth know that I stand with her.

name: Haunting Protector
text: Feel the chill of the grave!

name: Armond Thaco
text: Damn, $n! Back at it again with the sweet shades!

name: Prince Malchezaar
text: Your greed, your foolishness has brought you to this end.

name: Shattered Hand Legionnaire
text: Line up and crush these fools!

name: Kilrogg Deadeye
text: I've been waiting for this day!

name: Skyhorn Pathfinder
text: They took some of our people deeper into the Enclave.

name: Grand Admiral Westwind
text: Kirel narak! I am Mal'Ganis. I AM ETERNAL!

name: Draenei Refugee
text: It's not that far. Come on, just jump already!

name: Majordomo Executus
text: I go now to summon the lord whose house this is. Should you seek an audience with him, your paltry lives will surely be forfeit! Nevertheless, seek out his lair, if you dare!

name: Shadowdirge Soul Reaper
text: May the doors of Valhallas open for you.

name: Havi
text: I have had enough of that foul sorceress' games!

name: Kilrogg Deadeye
text: At last, this is the death I saw!

name: Helmouth Soulflayer
text: I will bathe in your blood!

name: Nightfallen Rebel
text: Champion, I have come to learn from you.

name: Proximity Alarm-o-Bot 2000
text: Stealth Detection Systems Online. Invisibility Flare Booting up...

name: Twilight Aquamancer
text: Your blood shall be the catalyst for the Old Gods' return!

name: Wrathguard Invader
text: Your relics cannot save you now!

name: Sara
text: Let hatred and rage guide your blows!

name: Dread Sharpshooter
text: Keep your eyes peeled. The admiral is not to be disturbed.

name: Razorfen Kraulshaper
text: They killed Bonetusk... we must hold them off!

name: Helix Gearbreaker
text: I didn't need him! Not when I've got YOU oafs!

name: Samuel Williams
text: You struggle at the surface... but He waits below.

name: Tichondrius
text: Show these pretenders how to fight!

name: Midnight
text: Who dares attack the steed of the Huntsman?

name: Oublion
text: What am I thinking? This fight is all yours, my queen.

name: Allari the Souleater
text: Quickly, $p, break the next soul gem.

name: Helix Gearbreaker
text: Only ten copper? You're not even worth killing!

name: Warlord Zaela
text: Warriors of the Dragonmaw! Retake the docks and drive the enemy into the sea! In the name of the True Horde!

name: Sara
text: Tremble, mortals, before the coming of the end!

name: Glrglrglr
text: So long, suckers. I'm out of here!

name: Tichondrius
text: You think getting past a few power-addled elves means you can stand against a true son of the Legion?

name: Apprentice Warlock
text: Together we will imprison these demons once again.

name: Wormtalon Witch
text: I will rip you to shreds!

name: Duskwatch Moonmage
text: An illusion! What are you hiding?

name: Moira Thaurissan
text: Aye. I am loathe to send my men into that. It reeks of ambush and bloody disaster.

name: Throm'var Villager
text: Why does the ground shake? Are we under attack?

name: Master Bu
text: Your skills are impressive indeed, Grandmaster! I would be honored to serve you, as I served the great leaders of our order who came before.

name: Succubus
text: I have waited a long time for this, Cazarian! Now the whip is in the other hand!
